attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact NEAR-ROUND mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair, brows, conditional facial hair, clothes. A clearly ROUNDED SHORT U-SHAPED lower yellow head, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw, immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual open/closed garment and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Actual WHITE peaked naval cap with DARK band, GOLD decorative band/central fitting and dark visor, exposed short GREY/BROWN temple hair and real brows. Clean understated upper lip/chin with no distinct separate moustache or beard, serious CLOSED mouth. DARK NAVY OPEN naval coat, real WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK BLACK/GREY subtly patterned necktie visible beside note. Preserve exact primary near-frontal slight angle/roll, grey backing/light and note-limited crop, no spectacles or hidden medal rows. Tiny upper-lip shadow and cap engraving genuinely indistinct remain understated.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged primary/matched analysis context, raw master, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Correct actual white peaked naval cap/dark and gold bands/fitting/visor, exposed grey-brown temple hair/brows, clean understated upper lip/chin, serious closed mouth, near-frontal source angle and open navy coat/pale shirt/dark patterned tie. Reject yellow pointed triangular lower face at narrow collar opening instead of short rounded chin and broad contact; repair geometry only. Complete frame/backing/note and dark cloth opaque without visible cyan holes; fine cap/facial shadow details understated.
